text: that landed but it landed upside down haha also can u make it work like text in any normal editor, where i can place it and move it around, just treat it like a layer
resolution: Reworked the text tool from a one-click bake into a movable LAYER, like a normal editor, and fixed the upside-down landing. Clicking a face captures the texture beneath the text (a base snapshot) and composites the typed string on top; dragging re-raycasts and re-composites (restore base then re-stamp) so the text glides over the 3D surface. The panel gains 'place' (bakes it; one undo lifts the whole text) and 'cancel' (restores the surface). Editing the string, brush size, or colour re-stamps live. Leaving the text tool or paint mode auto-bakes a pending layer so work isn't lost; the per-move full-texture re-composite is throttled to ~30fps. Upside-down fix: each glyph's rows are flipped within its line (atlas-Y runs opposite to surface-up), preserving multi-line order. Added paintDropUndoSnapshot() to meshPaintTexture for the cancel path. Verified: hmsc-int bundles clean via the real esbuild flags, paint kit suite 21/21. Live drag/orientation needs rjit dev (headless shot can't capture Paintable).
